name: diagram-design
description: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
one_liner: A free tool that turns a written explanation into a clean, professional-looking diagram (like a flowchart or org chart) automatically, matching your brand's colors, instead of a generic-looking chart.
buyer: A startup founder or content marketer who needs polished diagrams for pitch decks, blog posts, and investor updates but can't afford a designer or 30 minutes in Figma per image.
business_use_cases: A B2B SaaS marketing team uses it to auto-generate on-brand architecture and workflow diagrams for blog posts and documentation, replacing outsourced design work.
A startup founder generates pitch-deck diagrams (funnel, roadmap, org chart) in their brand colors the night before an investor meeting instead of paying a freelance designer a rush fee.
A technical writer at a mid-size company standardizes all internal documentation diagrams so they look consistent without a shared design system.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'brand-matched diagram pack' service: read a client's website once, then generate a set of on-brand diagram templates for them.
Build a hosted version with a simple UI (no coding-agent required) aimed at marketers, priced per month.

steal_this: This weekend, build a simple web form where someone pastes their website URL and a rough diagram description, and get back a branded SVG diagram — charge $10 per diagram or $29/month unlimited.
